package store

// Fixture generator for internal/core/migrate. It is copied into a throwaway
// worktree of the OLD release (v0.1.20 or v0.1.22-rc.59) as
// internal/teams/store/zz_cxp_fixture_gen_test.go and run there, so the
// fixtures are written by the real old store code (see gen.sh).

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestCXPFixtureGen(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("CXP_FIXTURE_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("CXP_FIXTURE_OUT not set")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	tag := os.Getenv("CXP_FIXTURE_TAG")
	apply := func(files ...string) func(*State) error {
		return func(st *State) error {
			for _, f := range files {
				raw, err := os.ReadFile(f)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				raw = bytes.ReplaceAll(raw, []byte("FIXTURE_TAG"), []byte(tag))
				if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, st); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
			return nil
		}
	}
	seeds := strings.Split(os.Getenv("CXP_FIXTURE_SEEDS"), ",")
	walSeed := os.Getenv("CXP_FIXTURE_WAL_SEED")

	// Full-JSON form.
	jdir := filepath.Join(out, "json")
	must(t, os.MkdirAll(jdir, 0o700))
	s, err := Open(filepath.Join(jdir, "state.json"))
	must(t, err)
	must(t, s.Update(ctx, apply(seeds...)))
	must(t, s.Close())

	// SQLite pointer form, plus a copy taken while the store is still open
	// after one more write (rows that may live only in the -wal file).
	qdir := filepath.Join(out, "sqlite")
	must(t, os.MkdirAll(qdir, 0o700))
	s, err = Open(filepath.Join(qdir, "state.json"))
	must(t, err)
	must(t, s.Update(ctx, apply(seeds...)))
	res, err := s.MigrateLargeStateToSQLite(ctx, 0)
	must(t, err)
	t.Logf("sqlite migration: %+v", res.Migrated)
	must(t, s.Close())
	copyDir(t, qdir, filepath.Join(out, "sqlite-pre-wal"))
	s, err = Open(filepath.Join(qdir, "state.json"))
	must(t, err)
	must(t, s.Update(ctx, apply(walSeed)))
	copyDir(t, qdir, filepath.Join(out, "sqlite-wal"))
	must(t, s.Close())
}

func copyDir(t *testing.T, src, dst string) {
	t.Helper()
	must(t, os.MkdirAll(dst, 0o700))
	ents, err := os.ReadDir(src)
	must(t, err)
	for _, e := range ents {
		if e.IsDir() || strings.HasSuffix(e.Name(), ".lock") || strings.HasSuffix(e.Name(), "-shm") || strings.Contains(e.Name(), ".bak.") {
			continue
		}
		in, err := os.Open(filepath.Join(src, e.Name()))
		must(t, err)
		o, err := os.Create(filepath.Join(dst, e.Name()))
		must(t, err)
		_, err = io.Copy(o, in)
		must(t, err)
		in.Close()
		must(t, o.Close())
	}
}

func must(t *testing.T, err error) {
	t.Helper()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
